author: dotviv
name: Quarantine
install_msg:
Thank you for installing Quarantine!
Run `[p]quarantineset` to begin.
short: Quickly quarantine troublesome members for a quick chat.
description: Quarantine members for a quick chat with mods. Members lose all roles, and regain them when quarantine is lifted. Chats take place in a private generated channel that's cleaned up afterwards.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the Discord user ID, role assignment, and a transcript of any related messages sent during quarantine.
